name: @salon/snippet
description: The embeddable widget: one <script> tag a client puts on their own site. Plain TS bundled by esbuild into a single IIFE — no React, no framework — because this file is injected into someone else's page and every kilobyte and every global is theirs, not ours. Shares the engine transport with web/site via @salon/shared/chat so the reply-mapping contract has exactly one source.
